races.display_title: Racing TV Free Trial For A Month Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: ZARA'S DREAM didn't shape with masses of promise in a bumper at Ballinrobe 3 months ago but she couldn't be in better hands and will surely up her game here. races.display_title: Joe Fanning Fond Farewell Handicap
races.verdict: Jim Goldie holds a strong hand here with AIGHEAR and Storm On Jura both arriving in top form, the former shading preference in search of a quick-fire hat-trick. Charlie Darling and Ned Broy are others making appeal, whilst last year's easy winner Quercus Robur would also enter the reckoning if ready to roll after 7 months off. AIGHEAR STORM ON JURA CHARLIE DARLING (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Aighear (9/4), Storm On Jura (3/1), Rich Belief (10/3), Queen Roslyn (9/2), Ned Broy (7/1), Galahad Threepwood (9/1), Quercus Robur (10/1), Charlie Darling (11/1), Bollin Neil (14/1), Neddies Boy (20/1), Nothingbutadream (25/1), Sugarpiehoneybunch (50/1)

races.verdict: CAVALLO PAZZO has been revitalised by the application of a visor in recent weeks, really impressing with how he travelled when defying a 10 lb weight rise at Newcastle on Friday. Wisely turned out under a penalty, he looks a big player in his hat-trick bid, with Motawaared , Empirestateofmind , Ablon and Tolstoy other likely protagonists in an interesting affair. CAVALLO PAZZO (IRE) MOTAWAARED EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Empirestateofmind (3/1), Tolstoy (7/2), Motawaared (7/2), Barley (7/1), Cavallo Pazzo (15/2), Good Morning Alex (8/1), Ablon (14/1), Izzari (22/1), Escape Act (50/1), Quiet Resolve (50/1)

races.display_title: Nairns Oatcakes Handicap
races.verdict: A 3-time winner in 2025 (including over C&D) THE RESDEV SCHOLAR quickly got back on track when second behind a revitalised veteran at Catterick 8 days ago and hailing from a stable in form, he looks to hold solid claims from a handy draw. Rhoscolyn benefited from the drop into a 0-80 when scoring at Leicester and merits respect under a 4-lb penalty despite a wide draw. Homestrait and Quest For Fun are others worth a second look. THE RESDEV SCHOLAR (IRE) RHOSCOLYN HOMESTRAIT (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: The Resdev Scholar (3/1), Golden Mind (4/1), Quest For Fun (11/2), Rhoscolyn (6/1), Homestrait (7/1), Witch Hunter (17/2), Dandy Magic (10/1), County Carlow (20/1), Cargin Bhui (22/1), Count Palatine (22/1), Mudamer (33/1), Hunky Dory (50/1)

races.display_title: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: TELE RED returned to form when a close second at Leicester 9 days ago and is on a winning mark over a trip and ground that suits him, so he's well worth chancing up against younger rivals here. Arbaawy has been in consistent form with successive runner-up efforts and a deserved first success shouldn't be far away, while Royal Poetry ran better than her latest result suggests. TELE RED ARBAAWY ROYAL POETRY (IRE)

races.display_title: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: BORJINA was unlucky not to open her handicap account when narrowly beaten over C&D and looks the type that should win a similar event before long. Royal Saxo shaped much better than the bare result at Listowel when denied a run and has to be of interest making the trip over from Ireland, while Beach Point is as reliable as they come and can fill the placings. BORJINA ROYAL SAXO (FR) BEACH POINT (IRE)

races.display_title: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict: Having dropped back down to his last winning mark, INVINCIBLE SPEED ran well when fourth over this C&D in July and the race has produced several winners since. He is taken to add to his tally at the chief expense of Monsieur Patat . The Coffee Pod isn't easy to win with but is expected to be on the premises again. INVINCIBLE SPEED (IRE) MONSIEUR PATAT THE COFFEE POD (IRE)
